name: Fold, pocket and candidate-ligand model comparisons
description: Compare supplied structures/models and candidate ligands with declared computational models; return ranked or geometric hypotheses whose tested chemical coverage is explicit.

capability_operations.operation: Search or superpose selected folds and local pockets

inputs.query_structure: identified experimental structure or explicitly labeled model
inputs.method: named structural alignment/local pocket model and parameters

outputs.matches: ranked structural matches, aligned residues and coverage
outputs.geometry: superposition or local-site differences with confidence limits

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

capability_operations.operation: Score declared ligand candidates in explicit model states

inputs.receptor: selected structure/model, protonation, metal/cofactor and loop states

outputs.search_scope: included and excluded chemical classes; failed preparations retained

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

repository_catalog_defined: No executable DALI, Foldseek, structural-superposition, receptor-modeling or docking callable was confirmed in the inspected repository catalog.
research_operations_performed: Primary authors computational results were inspected. No fresh fold search, homology model, docking, molecular dynamics or structure refinement was run in this 142-group research.
capability_specifications_not_confirmed_: All operations in this option require an explicitly supplied implementation and resource/data binding before execution.
author_experiments_are_source_evidence_o: Ligand-bound crystallography and biochemical substrate panels remain source evidence, not provided assays.
availability.binding_limit: A repository catalog definition is confirmed source-code identity, not proof of caller enablement, service availability, installed dependencies or execution in this research. Research scripts are retained operations, not registered runtime tools.

limits: A score ranks the submitted chemical library under a model; missing compounds were not tested and scores are not activity probabilities.
Changing loops, receptor state or a metal model changes the computational hypothesis.
Fold similarity may yield no useful function distinction; model agreement does not replace native-role evidence.
